name: magic mouth
lore:
### The Arcane Artifice: *Magic Mouth*

*Magic Mouth* is far more than a mere parlor trick; it is the art of imbuing the inanimate with a fleeting soul. Upon its triggering, the target surface ripples like a pebble cast into a still pond, manifesting as a pair of translucent, gossamer lips that mimic the caster’s own cadence with eerie precision. 

To shape the Weave for this enchantment is to feel a rhythmic thrumming in the fingertips, akin to threading a silver needle through the very fabric of reality to stitch a memory of sound into cold matter. It is a delicate, vibrating tension that settles into a quiet hum once the "stitch" is complete.

Chroniclers trace the spell’s genesis to the Archmage Vaelen the Mute. Desiring to lecture his disciples without the strain of speech, he sought to make his library speak for him. Legend claims he succeeded so thoroughly that his favorite lectern eventually began to argue with him regarding the finer points of planar geometry.

Whether used for a sentry’s warning or a grand theatrical entrance, handle the resonance with care—lest your own furniture begin to gossip.
